metrics.pet_unavailable_reason: Conflict-area entry and exit occupancy intervals are not established
metrics.footprint_assumption: Circular road-user footprints; configurable radius, approximate and not class-specific
metrics.uncertainty: Constant velocity prediction; excludes turning, occlusion and identity switches

events.reason: Predicted footprint interaction from timestamped road-contact trajectories.

measurement_quality.uncertainty: Constant velocity prediction; excludes turning, occlusion and identity switches

limitations: Planar road homography; lens distortion is not corrected.
Calibration residual is not independent ground-truth validation.
PET is reported only from observed sequential occupancy in configured shared conflict areas.
Variable-frame-rate output uses presentation timestamp deltas through FFmpeg when available; otherwise an explicitly untimed CFR preview is used.
